title: Hiphop 04
name: hiphop-04
arc:
Smooth Criminal part two, with sharper arms. The figure steps on the character-right foot, the character-left arm folds tight at shoulder height at frame 1, the weight trades feet through frames 2-7, and a hop carries frames 10-13 before landing.

Arms punch between folded and bent. Pingpong: frames 0 and 18 are grounded turnarounds.
